selectbatsman.msg: Higher the rating of the batsman, lower the chances of him getting out. Higher the strike rate, higher the chances of scoring runs on each ball.

expBat1.msg: Hey Champion! Let’s get started with the basics of batting

expBat2.msg: Each ball has 12 possible outcomes in the form of runs, wickets and extras

expBat3.msg: Your decision as a batsman will determine whether you score or get out!

expBat4.msg: You can score 0-3 runs on a ball

expBat8.msg: While batting, you can either Defend or Attack a ball

expBat9.msg: If you choose to Defend, one dice is rolled with an outcome between 1 and 6. You have fewer runs on offer but also lower your chances of getting out. Click DEFEND to continue

expBat10.msg: If you choose to Attack, two dice are rolled with an outcome between 2 and 12. You have more runs on offer but also increase your chances of getting out. Click ATTACK to continue

expBat11.msg: Let’s try hitting a few of them in the nets...

onBowl1.msg: That's a Full Toss for you first up. Go ahead, Attack this one

onPlay1.msg: That was a good shot, get ready for the next one

onBowl2.msg: That's a Yorker, you need to be careful with this one. It is safer to Defend

onPlay2.msg: That was well negotiated, now get ready for the next one

onBowl3.msg: That's a Good Length ball, chance your arm and Attack

onPlay3.msg: What a SHOT!! You’re getting a hang of it. Now lets understand Wickets and Chances better

onBowl4.msg: That's another Good Length ball, lets see what happens when you Defend

onRollAgain4.msg: You get chance to Roll 2nd Dice, remember defending let’s you roll again when you land in Danger and lowers your chance of getting out

onBowl5.msg: That's a Slower one, lets try to Attack this ball

onPlay5.msg: What just happened? Well, high-star batsmen may get a Chance in 10/20 over games. But you will not be so lucky the next time

onBowl6.msg: That's a Short Ball, let's take a chance and Attack this one

onPlay6.msg: Told you so! Here’s a tip for you. In a 20 over game, high-star batsmen are more likely to get at least one chance before getting out while low-star batsmen will get out straight away.

battingTutsOver.msg: Now that you have perfected your batting skills, lets bowl a few balls too..

glMsg.bowlMsg: Keep at it, you'll get this batsman next time

selectbowler.msg: Higher the rating of the bowler, better the chances of taking a wicket. Lower the economy rate, lower the chances of conceding runs on each ball.

info1.msg: Before the start of each over, you will get 6 cards from a deck of 30

info2.msg: High-star bowlers will have more Red Cards in their deck of 30, these are good deliveries with fewer runs and/or more wicket chances

info3.msg: Low-star bowlers will have more Green Cards in their deck of 30, these are loose deliveries with more runs and/or fewer wicket chances

cardExplain1.msg: Tap once to see the outcome for each delivery. Let’s start by tapping a Half-Volley

cardExplain2.msg: Now tap the Fast Yorker once to see the possible outcomes

cardExplain3.msg: As you can see, the Fast Yorker has more Red Skulls and fewer runs

cardExplain4.msg: Okay Champion! Now let’s actually bowl, for which you need to double tap a delivery.

onBowl1.msg: Let's start with a Full Toss, double tap the card

onBowl5.msg: Now, let's try a Slower ball. Double tap the card

onPlay5.msg: When you bowl an extra, a new ball shows up from the bowler's deck

onPlay7.msg: High Five! Now here are some more tips to help you understand who to bowl and who to send into bat

goToHome.msg: Well, that's it. Go on and win games Champion!
